title: List the tracks on each internal plane layer
summary: Walks the board's internal planes with InternalPlaneLayerIterator and lists the tracks on each with a board iterator filtered to that plane's TV6_Layer, plus a helper that inserts a plane into the layer stack and places a track on it.
phrasings: find tracks on power plane layers
loop over plane layers and their objects
add an internal plane to the layer stack
get track coordinates in mm relative to the board origin
